**The Growth team signs off, and any Growth engineer can approve.** Post the change in #growth-eng. This comes from a project memory dated 2026-09-01. I found no CODEOWNERS file or other in-repo rule that says otherwise.

An older memory named Dana Okafor as the required approver. Dana has since moved to Platform, so I marked that memory as challenged. It now points to the newer ownership record.

Two template rules apply when you edit the wording:
- The receipt template lives in `services/notifier/templates/` as `<event>.mjml`. Update its plain-text twin `<event>.txt` in the same change, because some corporate mail gateways strip HTML.
- Keep the template variables in snake_case and the same in both files.
